answer: Operator drag-net escrow: each wallet's rewards accrue to a shared escrow keyed to behavior clusters, not addresses. A walnut of evidence linking N wallets to one operator freezes the whole cluster's escrow. Honest operators post a nectar of collateral per cluster, slashed on collusion proof. Attackers must farm each identity as a genuinely independent cluster, paying full collateral and reward-splitting overhead per sable of yield.
